column1: # MerXen alias table TEMPLATE (placeholders only). The real table is private:
# one shared copy outside every repository, linked or copied as .aliases.tsv
# The loader refuses an unedited <placeholder> in the real column.
# Format: UTF-8, tab-separated, '#' starts a comment line, blank lines ignored.
#   alias        neutral alias used in tracked code, data, tests and docs;
#   kind         what the real string is (human_paired_donor, human_if_sample,
#   form         which real form the row holds: pair_id (samplesheet pair id;
#                to_real default), name (display nickname; display() default,
#                falls back to pair_id), number (bare donor number), bulk_column,
#                by to_real), deny (hook only). Forms are unique per alias,
#                ident   bare number touching '_' or '-' (scanner, docs only)
#                literal case-sensitive substring when translating data (the
#                hooks and the docs rewrite match it in any case)
#                regex   Python regex in the real column
#                none    never matched (a form only to_real/display return)
#   real         the real string (or regex for match=regex)
#   skip_paths   optional comma-separated globs of tracked paths where the row is
#                not checked (only a nickname that is also a public format name)
#   placeholder  optional text written instead of the alias (deny rows default
# --- Human paired donors (Xenium + MERSCOPE; HD1, HD2 development, HD3, HD4 held out)
# --- Human IF samples (MERSCOPE only; derived from the donor alias)
